required_reductions: gauge-off or zero-coupling limit reproduces the hash-pinned TECT functional
frozen or decoupled Psi limit reproduces the declared regulated Yang-Mills model or an explicitly weaker effective-gauge model
early_stop_conditions: either parent limit is recovered only by renaming or dropping unmatched terms
the gauge-invariant physical observable class is absent
a stochastic or gradient-flow time is identified with physical time without reconstruction
the finite-regulator energy is unbounded without a controlled prescription
static covariance or support preservation is substituted for the A13 production owner
first_trial_scope: one minimal finite-regulator model; HYB-00 through HYB-04 only
non_claims: not a pure Yang-Mills mass-gap result
not an A13, Sector-A, Pre-A, physical-empty, OS/KMS, thermodynamic or continuum closure
